environment: local x86-64, PostgreSQL18 Docker, pg_stat_statements track=all/track_planning=on, Redis DB15, disposable *_test database
method: Same production store_entries function from baseline/current git source; fresh fixture per variant, ANALYZE before measurement, pg_stat_statements_reset immediately before workload. SQLAlchemy events capture app calls, checkout and transaction intervals. PostgreSQL top-level totals include transaction control; nested trigger work is included in enclosing statement cost. Container CPU includes fixed cgroup-read probes/background maintenance and is one observation, not isolated backend CPU.
